sample_texts: On-device protection for feeds and short videos
Why not just use a timer?
A timer limits how long you use an app. AwayDoomscrollin' takes a different approach: it blocks supported feeds and short-video loops while keeping purposeful use available.
Messages, search and YouTube long videos remain available. Choose Strict or Balanced for Instagram and YouTube; Stories and selected short videos depend on your mode.
Works whatever language your apps use.
Protection decisions are made on your device.
The source code can be reviewed on GitHub.
Hi, I'm the independent developer behind Resolve Community and AwayDoomscrollin'.

During the COVID-19 pandemic, I started spending almost all day on my computer or phone. Life outside felt complicated. Gaming or scrolling for hours felt easier and safer than socializing. Looking back, I think I was trying to escape real life.

I realized that short-content habits were taking more time and attention than I wanted.

I wanted a clearer boundary that would help me get back to my studies and my goals.
Why did I build this app under Resolve Community?

Even when I was busy with something else, I'd find myself opening short videos without thinking. I built AwayDoomscrollin' under Resolve Community to create a clear boundary that holds even on tired days. I use it myself, and it keeps improving through testing and feedback from people who use it.

• Feeds automatically load the next item.
• Watch time and interactions can be used to personalize what appears next.
• Because there is no natural stopping point, a short visit can last longer than intended.
AwayDoomscrollin' was created to make room for study, work and intentional time. Protection is a tool; you can review its scope and choose the apps that fit your needs.

Clear boundaries for feeds and short videos
Home and Explore are covered and the Reels tab is blocked. Messages and account search remain available; the suggested grid under keyword search results is covered like Explore.
Profiles, profile posts, Stories and Highlights stay open, as do your Saved, Liked and Reposted lists. You can watch one Reel you open and use its comments; swiping to the next one takes you back.
Profile posts are covered. Reels (including those shared in messages), Stories and Highlights are blocked, and Saved, Liked and Reposted lists are closed.

Opening and browsing TikTok is allowed. The first swipe to the next video in a video feed takes you back, and on Home every top tab other than For You switches back to For You. TikTok has one protection setting, without Strict and Balanced modes.
Home is covered and the Shorts tab is blocked. Search results, channels, playlists, the You tab and long videos remain available.

Home is covered and the Shorts tab is blocked. Search results, channels, playlists, the You tab and long videos remain available.

Subscriptions stay open: they only show channels you chose to follow. You can watch one Short opened from Subscriptions, search, a channel or a link; swiping to the next one takes you back. Reading and scrolling comments do not count as changing videos.
Subscriptions are covered as well. All Shorts are blocked, including those opened from search, channels or links.

Screen information is processed on your device and never sent to a server; a short troubleshooting log stays on the phone only if you turn it on in About. Optional usage-data sharing is a separate choice. App or Android updates can affect detection.
What it can and cannot do
Here's what protection covers and how your information is handled:
All analysis and protection happen directly on your device. When optional usage data is off, nothing is sent to our server.
Protection reads the structure of the screen, not its text, so it works the same in any language.
You can turn protection off at any time, in the app or in Android's accessibility settings.
Changes to Instagram, TikTok or YouTube can affect how reliably protected screens are detected.
WHAT IT NEVER DOES OR COLLECTS
Does not save on-screen text or send screen information anywhere. Messages, passwords, photos and screenshots are never collected.
Does not include your name, messages or browsing history in usage reports. Sharing usage data is optional and off by default.
Does not show ads or sell personal data.

app_chain_summary_zh: 应用启动后进入5步引导：欢迎与开发者自述、逐平台说明阻断规则、范围与隐私承诺、应用与模式选择，最后点击Next前往权限步骤；全程仅说明与选择，无通知横幅或遮罩，拒权结果未测试。
observed_lure_rhetoric_zh: 英文 -> 为什么选择AwayDoomscrollin'：声称在设备端保护信息流和短视频（Step 1 欢迎页）
英文 -> 为何不用计时器：声称不是限制使用时长，而是阻断信息流并保留有目的的使用（Step 1 欢迎页）
英文 -> 通信仍可用：消息、搜索和YouTube长视频保留（Step 1 欢迎页）
英文 -> 保护决策在设备本地完成（Step 1 欢迎页）
英文 -> 无广告、开源、任意语言可用（Step 1 欢迎页）
英文 -> 只读屏幕结构不读文字，因此跨语言生效（Step 3 范围与隐私页）
英文 -> 不保存屏幕文字、不发送屏幕信息，不收集消息/密码/照片/截图（Step 3 范围与隐私页）
英文 -> 使用数据共享可选且默认关闭，不展示广告或出售个人数据（Step 3 范围与隐私页）

frame_captions_zh.step_01: 欢迎页说明阻断信息流与短视频、通信保留、本地处理与开源；本步下滑，无通知横幅或遮罩。
frame_captions_zh.step_02: 开发者自述信页，讲疫情期刷屏经历与创建动机，解释信息流无自然终点；本步下滑，无通知、无遮罩。
frame_captions_zh.step_03: 同一自述信下半页，出现“Start setup →”；本步点按进入设置，无通知横幅或遮罩。
frame_captions_zh.step_04: 第2/5步“如何运作”，分平台说明Instagram、TikTok、YouTube限制差异；本步下滑，无通知遮罩。
frame_captions_zh.step_05: 承接运作说明，列YouTube限制与本地处理隐私声明；本步点“Next →”前进，无通知、无遮罩。
frame_captions_zh.step_06: 第3/5步范围与隐私页，声称仅读屏幕结构、不存文字不传服务器、无广告；本步点Next，无通知遮罩。
frame_captions_zh.step_07: 第4/5步应用与偏好，选择YouTube平衡/严格，Instagram未安装；本步下滑，无通知、无遮罩。
frame_captions_zh.step_08: 承接应用选择页，显示TikTok未安装；本步点“Next →”前往权限步骤，无通知、无遮罩。
